verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents a public REST API with a browsable reference whose pages let you call endpoints live from the browser. Documented endpoints include headless checkout REST APIs and onramp/offramp order create and get operations, plus server- and client-side API keys and agent-facing APIs for cards, checkouts and wallets. All of this is first-party documentation, and an llms.txt probe returned HTTP 200. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
